summary: s05_finale v2 (storyboard_v2 section 3) is complete and previewed on the real hex-tile library (6 chapter tiles from finals, all 12 minis from preview loops, centre = S04 preview overscan). f1 is S04 f180 at 1:1. The camera then makes one continuous log-distance pull-back. Ring 1 holds the six chapter tiles (f8-20). The honeycomb fills the frame f40-53 (17-21 full tiles, 70-78 % covered), with ripple POPs on 8th notes (f8.5/23.5/31/38.5). The white orb swells out of the girl in white (POP f46) and glides to O, arriving at rest on f61, and the camera follows it down (tilt f48-68) to v1's end framing (at rest f82). The title is v1 +60, with identical lockup. Screens are proven true-colour through Blender's REAL PBR Neutral view: a closed-form inverse plus a 97^3 correction LUT, because Blender implements the view as a 57^3 tetrahedral LUT in lg2 space. The calibration render passes with margin (real frame mean 0.12 / p99 0.49 per 255). Screen light is gated by ray length, so the screens light only their own bezels and the title section matches v1 (mean |d| 1.18/255 below y 420; it was 20/255 before the fix). Bloom comes only from the halo AOV, and the final guard works. Final cost is about 0.40 GPU-h for 180 frames (cap 0.7).

deviations: Screen inverse = closed-form Khronos inverse x a 97^3 correction LUT, not the closed form alone. Blender implements 'Khronos PBR Neutral' as lg2 allocation [-9, 10] -> pbrNeutral.cube 57^3 (tetrahedral) -> sRGB, and the closed form misses that by up to ~6/255 (p99 6.3) on saturated colours. Textures are read as Non-Color.

Screens light only their own bezels and slabs. Secondary rays longer than 0.10-0.22 m see a wall-like lavender BSDF, and the screens are excluded from the Fill light. Without this the 77 full-radiance screens re-lit the cove (floor 20/255 warmer than v1 below the honeycomb).
f1 is rendered with a closed shutter and a 0.01 px filter (keyed to 1.5 by f5). The linear camera keys f1 -> f2 otherwise put ~1.3 px of zoom blur at the frame edges into the match frame.

End tile size ~160 px (screen; bezel 174), at the low end of 160-260. With a complete bottom row (needed for >= 70 % coverage at the many-scenes moment) and the lime split orb at y ~367 px, the honeycomb must end <= ~335 px near the centre. The painting tile's bezel sits 4.5 px under the frame top.
Orb glide f46-61 peaks at ~15 cm/f (> the 10 cm/f light rule). It must cover 1.5 m in 15 frames. The lamp stays off while fast (ramps f56-61) and the orb is <= 10 cm/f from f58.
Letters are hidden until their v1 fall start (v1 kept them hanging out of view from f1); L enters from the left edge during the pull-back (f57-60) instead of from the top.
Camera rests on v1's end framing at f82 (spec SETTLE ~f70-80): it is within 1 % of the end distance from f71, overshoots 1.1 % at f75 and returns by f82; v1's 1 % push starts f84.
open_issues: Tile library is not final yet (minis = preview loops, centre = S04 preview overscan). The final guard refuses until make_hex_tiles.py --require-final passes. Re-run the preview pass after the finals if the critic wants to see them.

S04 overscan mirror artefact (lead knows): the mirrored strip above the painting folds tree trunks into V/diamond shapes at the top of the centre hex. It is clearly visible ~f10-22 (zoom-blurred, ~13 % of the centre hex height), small by f25, gone from view once the painting is a ~270 px tile. No workaround in this script.

Title-unchanged letter boxes were measured on preview images (1 px = 2 px @1080). A final-res check belongs in qa_finals.py --film v2 once both finals exist; v1's own script cannot be used for a mask render because it rewrites renders/meta/s05_title.json.

Final seam vs S04 final f180 not measured (no S04 final yet). The transfer itself is exact at final res (0.11/255 vs the still's centre crop), so the seam will equal S04's own overscan-vs-f180 difference (0.78/255 at preview).
Out-of-gamut tile pixels (saturated colours with a channel at 255, e.g. flat palette placeholders) show near-white on the screens. No real render contains them.
notes_for_critic: Look at: (1) f1-20 for the match cut and the zoom blur. Peak pull-back speed is 7.8 %/frame at f18 with a 0.5 shutter, so the outer ring-1 tiles enter smeared radially while the centre stays crisp. Reduce E_A or extend E_FA if it reads too fast. (2) f40-53, the many-scenes moment: 17-21 full tiles of ~270 px, the orb born from the girl in white at f45-48. (3) f55-66: the honeycomb slides up and the stage is calm with only the orb (the v1 beat before the split). (4) The end band: 2.5 rows of 160 px tiles touching the frame top, at gain 0.75. Tunables: S05F_GAIN (0.65-0.85), S05F_KDIFF (bezel glow from the screens), S05F_COAT, camera clocks S05F_EA/EFA/EFB/EFC/ST/FOC/REST (verify letters with renders/work/s05_finale/tools/layout_probe.sh + layout_summary.py). The colour proof is in renders/work/s05_finale/calib/calibration_compare.png: the 4th swatch row is the raw palette hexes, which the view cannot display (shown for transparency, not a failure).
